item.title: Law and Order: Batavia man accused of attempting to break into Alva Place business
item.description: Gage Wetmore Gage R. Wetmore, 19, of Batavia, is charged with attempted burglary 3rd, attempted criminal mischief 4th, and possession of burglary tools. Wetmore was arrested on Feb. 14. He is accused of attempting to break into a building on Alva Place on Feb. 2, 2026. Wetmore was arraigned in CAP Court and is due in Batavia City Court at a later date.
